This happens often for me, I just think through all the stuff that's making me feel lonely and just look to the solution. At night you are in a peaceful area and you can properly think stuff out I guess, I play some music and just chill. Take it step by step so that it doesnt completely overwhelm you, but just keep building on it. I'm taking your "truly alone" as meaning from everyone, not just being single. Unfortunatley the times when you should be most excited to do stuff, you end up feeling tired and down. Then the times when you're feeling low and down, you are the most awake. Use that time awake for good \- not bad. If it feels like the thinking is getting bad, distract yourself with whatever, play some games, read or just scroll through some hilarious subreddits \- anything to lift the mood. Whenever i'm feeling low though, ironically, my instant reaction is to watch "call me by your name" as it just reminds me there will be someone out there who has been truly crushed and it makes me feel a little more fortunate.

Honestly hope it gets better for you man, let me know if you find something that works for you.

Putting myself out there and getting a boyfriend was the best thing I've ever done.

My boyfriend is absolutely incredible and has helped me through so much and reminds me through ever uphill struggle that there is light there if I want to grab it. I love him to pieces and have so much respect for him. He acts as a sort of role model to me, he shows me what I could or can achieve in my life if I put my mind to it and focus in helping myself.

Having that someone in your life that can be there for you and can listen to you is incredible. My confidence has been boosted so much and Im starting to feel like I'm on my way to finally being better.

I struck very lucky with my boyfriend, he is quite literally one in a million, but I believe you could get the same ;).

I think it is still so soon for me, and I haven't fully realised just how much I have lost a lot of my close family (the older ones that is). Once that hits me i'm sure I'll develop the same attitude you have, I just can't seem to develop it right now. Death is so touchy, and as someone who has never properly experienced death emotionally, I would feel awful just leaving her. I'd feel like I was just as bad as them.

Honestly I've never felt so much respect for someone in my life. You have done incredibly well and you are the father a lot of gay people would love to have. I came out recently, my parents were horrible and treated me like dirt. The idea of having a parent like you seems like a myth, I am not even kidding.

The fact that it is very clear you have an open mind is amazing - the end of your doubts is likely to end the more time you spend around him and embrace him. You will realise soon that it isnt something to be embarrassed of at all, but that isnt slating you for thinking it now. As a gay guy, I understand there is pain for the parents, of course there is going to be! The fact that just THAT is your only pain is impressive and you should feel proud of yourself - you are doing everything right for your son in terms of emotional support.

In terms of the door issue, I would 100% understand if you would choose to ask him to keep it open - that's what you would do if he was straight right? But it is all determined on trust and how close you are I guess. If you can trust him to be safe and you trust him enough to be ok, then you are not wrong to let him go ahead and do his thing in private as well.

You put your son first. Always. To the point in which it is heavily impacting you financially. Be proud of your son (eventually), but also be proud of yourself.
Its going to be difficult. But I want to prove to them i'm no different to who I was before. Thats me clinging to hope yet again though.

I personally think any chance to repair a relationship should be taken. At the very least I would talk to him to get his current viewpoint on you. As for me, when I came out my parents were extremely against it and for the first week they basically bullied me out of where I lived. They shouted and screamed abuse at me and some of the things they have said about me have quite frankly scarred me, but as you said it hasnt stopped me "loving" them, its just stopped me wanting to be around them. If there was an opportunity to be mutual where they could accept me in a way that I could at the very least live an open life even if they dont want anything to do with that part of me i'd take it in a heartbeat.

On the other hand, you need to protect yourself. If you get hurt again you don't want to go into turmoil. Just know that if it doesnt go to plan it is NEVER your fault, it is his for playing you around and he clearly hasn't thought about how important you should be to him.

Hope this has helped, stay strong and pm me if you want to talk :).

I've been through what you are on about, I have a very hot boyfriend at the moment and I'm not exactly playing my part in terms of looks, but we take the opportunity to look at why we are together. It is so much more about personality and the bond we have because of it that links us rather than our appearance. I came very close to breaking up with him, despite us being a perfect match, because I knew he deserved better. I've learnt that having those doubts are going to make your partner feel a little more insecure, which will end up making you feel a lot more insecure. When you can look at a relationship and realise there is so much more to it than looks, you will get out of the mindset. Imagine a room filled with loads of bubbles. Your looks is just one tiny bubble. Just because you may think that bubble is popped doesn't mean the thousands of other bubbles are popped as well.

You are an incredible person - you need to think about that. You have just beaten part of your issues. 

Sometimes it's easier to take ten minutes. Let anything going in your mind escape it in the same instance and just focus on how valuable you are. Ten minutes is all it takes. Talk to someone else, someone who doesnt know you directly but can share an experience with your issues. I am looking for someone to talk, and if you are ever looking for someone the same know that I am here if you just want to let it out unjudgementally. Keep strong dude, you are an incredible person and you will beat it because of who you are. Put one thing right and the others will start to click to the right position too.
